parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: The switch is the handle of the faucet, typically made of stainless steel, used to control water flow and temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the water on or off and adjust the temperature by rotating or lifting the handle.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or tilt around a pivot point to regulate water flow and temperature.

parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame is the main body of the faucet, made of brass for durability and corrosion resistance.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal water channels and connects the spout and switch to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural support for the faucet assembly.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: The spout is the curved outlet of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water stream into the sink and may include an aerator to control flow and reduce splashing.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
